score_reasons.quality: Direct-flash photographic look is convincingly rendered: specular hotspots on the nose, cheekbones and collarbones fall off naturally into a dark background, exactly as harsh on-camera flash behaves. Ribbed tank-top texture, loose knit cardigan fibers and the thin silver chain are all sharply resolved with believable material response. Skin shows natural pores and blush gradient without plastic sheen; film grain is present but fine. No anatomical distortions, no visible artifacts; only very slight over-smoothing on the forehead keeps it from 10.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Well-balanced centered portrait with a candid snapshot mood; warm muted palette with dusty rose blush against beige/tan clothing is harmonious. Facial anatomy is correct, gaze direct and engaging, slightly parted glossy lips read naturally. Background clutter adds authentic atmosphere without distracting from the subject.
score_reasons.alignment: Young Asian woman with long dark wavy hair and wispy bangs: matched. White ribbed tank top: matched. Delicate silver necklace: matched. Soft makeup, pink blush, glossy lips, direct gaze, slightly parted lips: matched. Dim messy room with clothes on a table and a wooden shelf with folded clothes: matched. Flash-lit candid film aesthetic with muted color: matched. Minor deviation: the beige knit cardigan has slipped off both shoulders rather than 'one shoulder'.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: All elements withstand real-world scrutiny: clothing, necklace, room furniture and folded garments are ordinary and correctly depicted; no landmarks or cultural artifacts to verify; depiction is respectful and non-problematic.
score_reasons.creative_generation: Execution of the candid-flash film-snapshot concept is strong, with good tonal hierarchy (lit subject vs murky interior) and convincing amateur framing. The concept itself is a fairly conventional portrait template, so imagination headroom remains; not counted against execution quality.

unfulfilled_requirements: Cardigan is slipping off both shoulders instead of the specified single shoulder
